purpose: Bind the first pretraining data comparison before main pretraining. This packet defines a finite scientific design; it does not select sources, authorize acquisition, admit training data or promise a token horizon.
program_direction: The first report centers on data quality, data mixtures and staged training, supported by one bounded architecture/efficiency comparison. The backbone is frozen before this study; broad architecture searches are deferred.

common_contract.backbone: Chosen after the bounded architecture/efficiency study; near-1.2B reference family only.
common_contract.tokenizer: Frozen Mistral 32K tokenizer bound by the model experiment.
common_contract.objective: Next-token prediction with identical serialization and optimizer policy across arms.
common_contract.initialization: Fresh paired initializations. Baseline and candidate within a pair share identical initial model tensors; optimizer and data state start fresh.
common_contract.exposure: Same complete-update token horizon per comparison, frozen from the slowest measured arm. Research exposure is not production exposure.
common_contract.packing: Same document boundaries, packing policy, sequence length, validation schedule and checkpoint milestones.
common_contract.evaluation: Fixed held-out source/domain loss plus predeclared development capability and retention checks; final tests remain untouched.
common_contract.accounting: Report preparation, acquisition, retries, allocated idle GPUs, training, evaluation and recovery separately; charge each operation once.

candidate_sources.web_control: FineWeb-Edu or another source-use-qualified independent web control; current retained inventory is not yet admitted.
candidate_sources.web_candidate: Pinned Ultra-FineWeb L1 English/HQ route at revision 02c85641e3d19a854be2e09139c25adaa9518063; cutoff and review flags remain unchanged until qualification.
candidate_sources.ai_provenance_filter: A calibrated AI-generation/provenance filter applied to the same eligible bank as its unfiltered control; detector precision, recall, calibration drift and false-positive coverage loss must be measured before any filtering decision.
candidate_sources.natural_code: One qualified natural-code contrast selected from the fixed Stack-Edu / Stack v3 evidence, subject to source, family and finite-supply gates.
candidate_sources.checked_code: Optional substitution only if independently verified checked-code supply is qualified; it cannot be silently used to fill the natural-code arm.
candidate_sources.math_and_supporting_banks: Held constant across the study after their own source, overlap, correctness and supply gates.

required_properties: all selected banks pass source-use and family gates
finite unique token count supports the common horizon
validation families are disjoint from training and final evaluation

arms.contrast: Replace only the declared natural-code bank route, or use independently qualified checked-code substitution. Keep all other banks, shares, serialization and exposure fixed.
arms.decision_scope: Do not compare natural-code and checked-code substitutions as separate extra arms. If neither route qualifies, remove this candidate and record the reduced study.

arms.contrast: Compare the qualified independent web control with the qualified Ultra-FineWeb HQ route at the same bank share. Do not tune score cutoffs, filters or serialization inside this arm.
arms.decision_scope: Exact overlap is counted once. Review flags remain review inputs until a source-aware decision is recorded.

arms.contrast: On the same qualified bank and exposure, compare an unfiltered control with a predeclared calibrated detector/filter policy. Report detector precision/recall, removed coverage, residual synthetic markers and downstream loss/capability; do not call a classifier score ground truth.
arms.decision_scope: Filtering is a bounded ablation, not a universal synthetic-data verdict. Preserve a no-filter control, freeze detector/version/threshold before training and reject the contrast if detector quality or coverage loss is unmeasured.

screening.order: Run baseline plus only candidates whose source and detector gates pass. Protect confirmation and support reservations before starting.
screening.primary_evidence: Held-out source/domain loss and development curves at matched exposure; capability and general retention are guardrails.
screening.selection_rule: A candidate advances only with a predeclared useful effect, no prohibited regression, reproducible format/packing and affordable measured cost. Raw code and web deltas are not ranked against each other.
screening.failure_rule: If no candidate passes, retain the qualified baseline or record an explicit redesign within the remaining reservation.

confirmation.selected_candidate: One passing screening candidate, or a documented baseline-only/inconclusive outcome.
confirmation.controls: Fresh paired initial tensors and fresh optimizer/data state; confirmation seeds differ from screening.
confirmation.evidence: Report each pair, family-level uncertainty, source-wise loss, target capability, general retention, preparation cost and regressions.
confirmation.claim_boundary: Two paired seeds support a bounded data comparison, not a global optimum or guaranteed 80B ranking.

decay_study.purpose: Test whether late-stage capability enrichment improves capability density over ordinary pretraining decay.
decay_study.parent: One matched stable-stage checkpoint from the selected broad recipe; all arms share model, optimizer state, decay schedule and total exposure.

arms.contract: Continue the qualified broad pretraining mixture through the declared decay schedule.
Increase qualified code, math, STEM and instructional data while preserving source-family accounting and broad replay.

arms.role: Curated decay with verified derived data
arms.contract: Add a small separately identified share of source-grounded or independently checked derived records. No unverified generated text is admitted.

decay_study.primary_evidence: Capability density per token and GPU-hour, general-retention guardrails, downstream SFT convergence, lineage and preparation cost.
decay_study.failure_rule: If derived or curated decay fails to improve the predeclared endpoints without prohibited regressions, retain natural decay and report the negative result.

support_and_reserve.budget_check: 120 base screening + 90 decay screening + 240 confirmation + 150 support = 600 pretraining-data-research GPU-hours.

required_gates_before_first_arm: Named human source-use decisions and applicable notices for every selected source.
Frozen source-family, exact and near-duplicate policy with disjoint training/development/final partitions.
Finite accepted unique-token counts and acquisition/storage cost per bank; no repeated-source assumption.
Independent correctness/oracle checks for claimed worked solutions, checked exercises and generated material.
Tokenizer, serialization, packing, context length, initialization and evaluation manifests hash-bound.
Measured GH200 single-worker and four-worker cost sufficient to freeze a common comparison horizon.
Backbone frozen after the bounded architecture/efficiency comparison.
required_outputs_for_report: Manifest fields, quality-weighted coverage distributions, lineage and contamination status under the shared data-design contract.
Source lineage, rights status, transformations, exclusions and accepted/rejected token accounting.
Exact mixture weights, exposure, repetition policy and held-out family construction.
Per-arm loss and capability curves versus tokens and allocated GPU-hours.
Preparation, storage, teacher/verification, training, evaluation, retry and idle costs.
Negative, inconclusive and failed-arm results with the same detail as selected results.
A clear separation between retained inventory, eligible supply, research exposure and production exposure.
boundary: No arm is launch-ready from this packet. A future launch request must bind a clean repository commit, qualified source manifests, rights and deny records, production operations, tokenizer, model, packed data and an explicit launch receipt.
